svg.title: Stiffness modifiers applied twice
svg.desc: Roof drift of the 3 by 2 frame: 9.66 mm with ACI factors applied once (columns 0.70, beams 0.35). Beam factor applied twice (0.1225): 16.76 mm; interior column base 112.1 to 140.2 kN·m, exterior column top at level 1 34.5 to 8.0 kN·m, level-1 beam end 57.1 to 37.9 kN·m. Both factors twice: 19.83 mm.
svg.text: Cracked factors entered as property modifiers and again in the section
Common routes to the double reduction:
a cracked-section option in the program plus a property modifier on the same members;
a reduced E for "cracked concrete" plus the I modifier; a template model with modifiers already set.
Effect here: drift ×1.74 (beams) and ×2.05 (all); interior column base 112.1 → 140.2 kN·m;
level-1 beam end 57.1 → 37.9, exterior column top 34.5 → 8.0 kN·m:
beams and column tops under-designed, column bases over-designed.
Check: read the effective I of one beam and one column from the model output and compare with
0.35 Ig and 0.70 Ig computed by hand.
